sourceText:
Peppered Round Steak
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 14, 2009 - 12:12am

Ingredients




 cup Olive Oil
1 1/2 pounds Top Round Steak, Cut 1 ½
pound Inches Thick (Up To 2  Can Be Used)
2 tablespoons Balsamic Or Red Wine Vinegar
Freshly Ground Black Pepper
2 tablespoons Marinade For Peppered Round
Steak
1 tablespoon Shallots, Minced
1 cup Heavy (Whipping) Cream
Salt And Coarsely Ground
Black Pepper

Preparation

1 Heat the oil until very warm but not sizzling. Place the meat in a shallow dish and pierce all over with a fork. Turn and pierce the other side. Pour half the warm oil on the meat and poke with a fork so that the oil penetrates the meat fibers. Turn and repeat the process on the other side. 2 Pour the vinegar over the steak and turn. Cover and marinate, at room temperature, about 2 hours or overnight in the refrigerator, piercing and turning the meat occasionally. Remove the meat, reserve the marinade, and sprinkle the pepper over the meat generously, pressing it in with the heel of your hand. Grill the meat 3-inches above the hot coals until browned then turn and grill the other side. Move to the edge of the grill and continue cooking until done as desired. This steak is the tenderest if grilled to rare, about 18 minutes to total cooking time or medium-rare, about 22 min 3 SHALLOT CREAM:In a small skillet, heat the marinade. Stir in the shallots and cook until lightly browned. Stir in the cream and cook, stirring often, until slightly reduced. Season to taste with the salt and pepper. Serve with the steak.
